findings.title: chronos_log::segmented segment header mis-counts gap entries, rejecting the segment on reopen
evidence: Any path that inserts a Gap into a SegmentedExecutionLog produces a segment header that declares N records but the on-disk file holds N-1. Both the record_gap direct API and the memory-budget overflow path reproduce it.

Observed error on reopen: 'replay integrity failure for session "rec-c1-8-uat03-gap": segment "...-100.seg" declares 101 records but holds 100' (record_gap path, flush_threshold=4096) and 'segment "...-0.seg" declares 1 records but holds 0' (memory_budget_bytes=128 overflow path).
Reproducer: chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_uat_c1_03_forced_gap.rs::uat_rec_c1_03_forced_gap_reports_gap_detected (currently #[ignore]-marked with a pointer to this finding).
Impact on REC-C1: blocks the positive arm of UAT-REC-C1-03 only. The negative arm (clean session -> complete) passes, and no other REC-C1 UAT depends on a recorded gap surviving a reopen.
Disposition: out of scope for REC-C1; belongs in a separate m1-* follow-up cycle that fixes segmented.rs segment-header bookkeeping for gap entries.
